Name: Barn and Coop Animal Plushies
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Decorate your home with cute plushies of barn and coop animals.  White and brown cows, goat, pig, sheep and ostrich (both baby and adult) plushies. White, brown, gold, blue and void chickens (both baby and adult) plushies. Baby and adult rabbits, dinosaur and duck plushies. 

Plushies can be found at both the Traveling Cart and/or the Oasis (your choice). They are also available from the furniture catalogue.

I have other mods you might like, take a look and let me know what you think.
